games.name: Pencil Pool
games.tagline: 8-ball on a sketchbook page, with a No. 2 pencil for a cue.
games.title: Pencil Pool: Free 8-Ball Pool Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Pencil Pool free online: 8-ball pool drawn in coloured pencil. Play a friend by text, share one phone or beat the bot. No downloads, no sign-ups.
games.lead: Pool, drawn in coloured pencil. Blue sinks the blue balls and pink sinks the pink ones, then whoever clears their colour first goes for the 8. Aim with a No. 2 pencil, pull back for power and let go. Sink a ball and you shoot again; scratch, and your friend gets ball in hand.
facts: Invite a friend by text and take turns whenever
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: invite a friend by text, pass one phone, or play the bot.
Touch the page behind the cue ball and pull back, like a slingshot. The pencil follows your finger, and the dotted line shows where the cue ball will go.
Pull further back for more power (watch the bar), then let go to shoot.
Sink one of your colour and you shoot again. Sink all seven, then the 8 ball, to win the round.
Scratch the cue ball, hit the wrong colour first or hit nothing and it's a foul: the other player can drag the cue ball anywhere before shooting.
Sink the 8 too early, or scratch while sinking it, and you lose the round.
controls: Drag back from the cue ball to aim and set power, then let go to shoot.
Ball in hand? Drag the cue ball to where you want it, then aim.
On a keyboard, the arrow keys aim (hold Shift for fine aim) and set power, and Space shoots.
New round racks the balls again. Mode switches who you play. The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Imagine a ghost ball touching your target on the far side from the pocket, and send the cue ball there. The dotted circle shows it.
Gentle shots are easier to control. Full power sends balls bouncing all over the page.
Leave the cue ball with a good next shot, not just a pot.
With ball in hand, line up a straight shot into a corner pocket.
about: Pencil Pool is 8-ball pool redrawn in a sketchbook, with coloured-pencil balls and a pencil for a cue.
The bot tries out shots with the same physics you play with. On Hard it rarely misses, so Easy is the one to learn on.

games.name: Doodle Kick
games.tagline: Flick soccer on a sketchbook page. First to three goals wins.
games.title: Doodle Kick: Free Flick Soccer Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle Kick free online: turn-based flick soccer drawn in pencil. First to three goals wins. Play a friend by text, one phone or the bot.
games.lead: Turn-based flick soccer, drawn in pencil. Each side has five players and there's one ball. Drag one of your players back like a pool cue and let it go: it skids across the page, knocks the ball about and everything bounces off the lines, the posts, the nets and each other. Score in the far goal; first to three wins, and every match starts in a new line-up.
facts: Invite a friend by text and take turns whenever
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: invite a friend by text, pass one phone, or play the bot.
On your turn, drag one of your five players back and let go to flick it. The further you pull, the harder the kick. A dotted line shows where it will go.
Everything slides and bounces until it stops, then it's the other side's turn. Players can skid into the back of the net and bounce back out.
Knock the ball into the far goal to score. Score in your own goal and the point goes to the other side. After a goal, the side that let it in kicks off.
First to three goals wins. Each match starts in a different line-up: three formations, then round again.
controls: Drag any of your players back, then let go to flick. Pull back only a little for a gentle nudge.
Your players have a dashed ring round them when it's your turn.
New round starts a fresh match. Mode switches who you play.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Hit the ball off-centre to curl it around a defender.
Keep one player back in front of your goal: a loose ball in front of an empty net is an easy goal.
Use a player as a wall: park one in front of your goal before you go for a long shot.
Bounce shots off the side lines when the straight path is blocked.
about: Doodle Kick is a pool-style soccer game: instead of running about, you flick your players across the page and let the ball bounce.
On Hard, the bot tries over a hundred different flicks before it picks one, so you'll need clever angles to beat it.

games.name: Guess My Doodle
games.tagline: Draw a word for your friend, then guess theirs.
games.title: Guess My Doodle: Free Draw & Guess Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Guess My Doodle free online: a draw-and-guess game for your group chat. Doodle a word, text it to a friend and guess theirs. No sign-ups.
games.lead: A draw-and-guess game for two. Pick a word, draw it on the sketchbook page, and send it to a friend. They watch your drawing appear line by line and try to guess the word, then draw one for you. Every word you get right adds to your team score.
facts: Invite a friend by text and take turns whenever
Or pass one phone back and forth
how: Pick who to play: invite a friend by text, or pass one phone back and forth.
On your turn, choose one of three words. Harder words are worth more.
Draw it with the coloured pencils. No letters or numbers allowed!
Your friend watches your drawing replay and taps letters to spell the word.
Guess it and you both score. Then it's the guesser's turn to draw. Ten drawings make a game.
controls: Draw with your finger or mouse. Undo takes back your last line, and Clear starts over.
Tap letters to fill the blanks, and tap a filled letter to take it back.
Skip shows the word if you're stuck.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Draw the biggest, simplest shape first. A sun is just a circle with lines.
Add one clue that makes it different: a cat needs whiskers, a dog needs a wagging tail.
Colour helps. A green circle and a red circle say very different things!
Guessing? Count the blanks, then try the letters that look most likely.
about: Guess My Doodle is a draw-and-guess game made for a sketchbook. Every word is quick to draw and fun to get wrong, from cat and pizza to volcano and lighthouse.
There are no accounts, names or chat. Only the friend you send the link to can see your drawings.

games.name: Sketch with Friends
games.tagline: Make words on the board with your letter tiles. Highest score wins.
games.title: Sketch with Friends: Free Word Tile Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Sketch with Friends free online: a word tile board game. Build words with your letters, play a friend by text or one phone, or beat the bot.
games.lead: A crossword-style word game for two. Each player has seven paper letter tiles. Take turns making words on the board that join onto the words already there, and land on the coloured squares to double or triple your points. Play a friend by text, pass one phone around, or take on the bot.
facts: Invite a friend by text and take turns whenever
how: Pick who to play: invite a friend by text, pass one phone, or play the bot.
Tap a tile in your rack, then tap a square on the board to place it. Make one word across or down.
The first word has to cover the star in the middle. After that, every word must join onto a word already on the board.
Tap Play to score. Letters have points, and coloured squares double or triple a letter or the whole word. Use all seven tiles for a 35-point bonus.
The game ends when the bag is empty and someone uses their last tile. Highest score wins.
controls: Tap a tile then a square, or drag a tile onto the board.
Tap a tile you just placed to take it back. Recall takes them all back, and Shuffle mixes your rack.
Swap trades tiles for new ones, and Pass skips your turn.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Look for the coloured squares. A word on a triple-word square can be worth a lot!
Short words that cross a big word's letters can score both ways.
Keep a mix of vowels and consonants. Swap if your rack is all one kind.
High-point letters like Q, Z and X are worth the most on a double or triple letter square.
about: The board checks words against a filtered version of the SCOWL US English dictionary. The game uses words from two to eleven letters and leaves out entries that need capitals or apostrophes. If a name or a contraction gets turned down, try building a shorter word across one already on the board.
games.guide_title: Which words does the board accept?

games.name: Sketchers
games.tagline: Checkers on a sketchbook page. Jump your friend's pieces to win.
games.title: Sketchers: Free Online Checkers Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Sketchers free online: classic checkers drawn in coloured pencil. Play a friend by text or on one phone, or take on the bot on Easy to Hard.
games.lead: Classic checkers, drawn in coloured pencil. Move your pieces diagonally, jump over the other player's pieces to capture them, and reach the far side to get crowned. Capture every piece, or leave your friend with no moves, to win.
facts: Invite a friend by text and take turns whenever
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: invite a friend by text, pass one phone, or play the bot.
Tap one of your pieces, then tap a highlighted square to move it one step diagonally forward.
Jump over the other player's piece into an empty square behind it to capture it. If you can jump, you have to, and you keep jumping while you can.
Reach the far side and your piece is crowned. Crowned pieces can move backward too.
Win by capturing every piece or leaving the other player with no moves.
controls: Tap a piece to pick it up, then tap where to move.
Pieces that must jump wiggle so you can spot them.
New round starts a fresh board. Mode switches who you play.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Keep your back row filled for as long as you can. It stops the other player getting crowned.
Move pieces in pairs so they protect each other from jumps.
Try to trade pieces when you're ahead.
Crown a piece as soon as you safely can. Kings are powerful!
about: Sketchers is checkers, one of the oldest board games in the world, redrawn on a sketchbook page.
On Hard, the bot looks several moves ahead, so you'll need to think carefully to beat it.

games.name: Connect Sketch
games.tagline: Drop your counters down the page. Four in a row wins.
games.title: Connect Sketch: Free Four in a Row Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Connect Sketch free online: drop-in four in a row drawn in pencil. Play a friend by text, share one phone or beat the bot on Easy to Hard.
games.lead: Drop coloured-pencil counters into a hand-drawn frame and be the first to line up four in a row: across, down or corner to corner. It's quick to learn and great to play with a friend, by text or on one phone.
facts: Invite a friend by text and take turns whenever
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: invite a friend by text, pass one phone, or play the bot.
Tap a column to drop your counter. It falls to the lowest empty space.
Get four of your colour in a row across, down or corner to corner to win the round.
Fill the whole frame with no four in a row and it's a draw. Who goes first swaps every round.
controls: Tap anywhere in a column to drop a counter.
On a keyboard, press 1 to 7.
New round starts a fresh frame. Mode switches who you play.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: The middle column is the strongest. Start there.
Before every move, check if the other player has three in a row with a gap. Block it!
Try to make two threats at once. They can only block one.
Watch out for diagonals. They're the easiest to miss.
about: Connect Sketch is a classic four-in-a-row drop game, drawn on a sketchbook page with coloured-pencil counters.
On Hard, the bot looks ahead several moves and almost never misses a threat.

games.name: Blot Sweeper
games.tagline: Uncover every clean square without touching an ink blot.
games.title: Blot Sweeper: Free Online Minesweeper Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Blot Sweeper free online: hand-drawn minesweeper with ink blots instead of mines. Easy, Medium and Hard boards. Works on phone and computer.
games.lead: The classic number-logic puzzle, with ink blots hiding under the paper instead of anything scary. Tap a square to uncover it. Numbers tell you how many blots are touching that square, so you can work out where they are, flag them, and uncover every clean square to win.
facts: Your first tap is always safe
Saves your best on each level
how: Pick a level. Easy is 8×8 with 10 blots, Medium is 9×11 with 18, and Hard is 10×13 with 30.
Tap any square to start. Your first tap is always safe and opens up part of the page.
Each number shows how many ink blots touch that square, including diagonally.
Mark squares you know are blots with a flag: switch to Flag, or press and hold a square.
Uncover every clean square to win. Uncover a blot and the page is ruined.
controls: Tap a square to uncover it.
Switch to 🚩 Flag, press and hold, or right-click to put a flag on a square.
Tap a number when all its blots are flagged to uncover everything around it at once.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Start with the 1s next to corners. They often point to exactly one blot.
If a 1 touches only one covered square, that square is a blot. Flag it!
If a number already has all its blots flagged, every other square around it is safe.
Look for the 1-2-1 pattern along an edge: the blots sit under the two 1s.
about: Blot Sweeper is our take on minesweeper, the logic puzzle that came with computers for years. We swapped the bombs for ink blots, because a notebook doesn't explode, it just gets messy.
Every page is random, and your first tap is always safe, so you never lose on a lucky guess.

games.name: Save the Doodle
games.tagline: Guess the word before the eraser rubs out the doodle.
games.title: Save the Doodle: Free Online Hangman Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Save the Doodle free online: a hangman word game. Guess letters before the eraser rubs out the doodle. Easy to Hard word lists with clues.
games.lead: A friendly spin on hangman. A hidden word is shown as blanks with a clue, like Animal or Food. Guess one letter at a time. Every wrong letter makes the eraser rub out part of the little pencil doodle, so fill in the word before it's gone!
facts: Saves your best on each level
Builds a streak of words in a row
how: Pick a level. Easy has short words and 7 tries, Medium has longer words and 6 tries, and Hard has tricky words and 5 tries.
Read the clue, then tap a letter.
If the letter is in the word, it's written in every blank where it belongs.
If it isn't, the eraser rubs out part of the doodle.
Fill in the whole word to save the doodle and add to your streak.
controls: Tap a letter, or type it on a keyboard.
New puzzle gives you a new word.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Start with vowels: A, E, I, O and U.
Next try common letters like T, N, S, R and L.
Use the clue! An Animal with three letters and an O in the middle could be DOG or FOX.
Look at the length. Long words often end in -ING or -ER.
about: Save the Doodle is hangman without the hanging. Instead of drawing a scary picture, the eraser rubs out a happy doodle, and your job is to save it.
The words are grouped into clues like Animal, Food and At school, so every guess starts with a hint.

games.name: Doodle Doku
games.tagline: Fill the grid so every row, column and box has 1 to 9.
games.title: Doodle Doku: Free Online Sudoku Puzzles | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle Doku free online: sudoku on a sketchbook page. A new puzzle every game with one answer, plus notes, hints and Easy to Hard levels.
games.lead: Classic sudoku on a pencil grid. Fill every empty square so each row, each column and each 3×3 box has the numbers 1 to 9 exactly once. Every puzzle is new and has exactly one answer, with notes for your pencil guesses and three hints if you get stuck.
facts: Saves your best on each level
how: Pick a level. Easy starts with about 40 numbers, Medium about 32, and Hard as few as 25.
Tap an empty square, then tap a number to write it in.
Each row, column and 3×3 box needs 1 to 9 with no repeats.
A wrong number turns orange and counts as a mistake. Mistakes never end the game.
Fill the whole grid to win. Your best time on each level is saved.
controls: Tap a square, then a number. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and type 1 to 9.
Notes lets you pencil in small guesses. Erase clears a square.
Hint fills in the square you picked (or a random one), three times per puzzle.
The small number under each button shows how many of that number are still to place.
tips: Look for a row, column or box that's almost full first.
Pick a number and scan for where it can go in each box.
If a square can only take one number, write it in.
Use notes when two squares in a box share the same two possible numbers.
about: Doodle Doku is sudoku with a sketchbook look. Every puzzle is made fresh when you start and checked to have exactly one answer.
We count mistakes but never end the game for them, so you can learn a hard grid at your own pace or just play it relaxed.

games.name: Crayon Code
games.tagline: Crack the secret row of crayon colours.
games.title: Crayon Code: Free Mastermind Code-Breaking Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Crayon Code free online: a Mastermind-style code-breaking puzzle with crayons. Crack the secret colours from dot clues. Easy to Hard levels.
games.lead: A code-breaking puzzle with crayons. There's a secret row of colours and you have to work it out. After each guess, dots tell you how close you are: a filled dot for every crayon in the right spot, and an open dot for every right colour in the wrong spot.
facts: Saves your best on each level
how: Pick a level. Easy is 3 colours from 4 crayons. Medium is 4 colours from 6. Hard is 4 colours from 6, and a colour can be used more than once.
Tap crayons to fill your row, then tap Check. Tap a filled spot to clear it.
A filled dot means a crayon is the right colour in the right spot.
An open dot means that colour is in the code, but in a different spot.
The dots don't line up with your crayons, so you have to work out which crayon each dot is about. Crack the code before you run out of rows.
controls: Tap a crayon to add it to the next empty spot.
Tap a spot in your row to clear it, or tap Clear to start the row again.
On a keyboard, press 1 to 6 for crayons, Backspace to undo and Enter to check.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Use your first guesses to find out which colours are in the code at all.
If a guess gets no dots, none of those colours are in the code.
Keep one crayon in the same spot and move the others to see which dot changes.
Your fewest guesses on each level is saved. Try to beat it!
about: Crayon Code is our version of the classic code-breaking game, often played with pegs, redrawn with a box of crayons.
It's a great first logic puzzle: Easy is short and simple, and Hard, with repeated colours, will make grown-ups think too.

games.name: Tic-Tac-Doodle
games.tagline: Blue X against pink O. Three in a row wins.
games.title: Tic-Tac-Doodle: Free Online Tic-Tac-Toe | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Tic-Tac-Doodle free online: hand-drawn tic-tac-toe on a sketchbook page. Play a friend on one phone or beat the bot. No downloads, no sign-ups.
games.lead: The classic paper-and-pencil game, drawn right on the sketchbook page. Blue X and pink O take turns, and the first to get three in a row wins the round. Pass the phone to a friend, or try to beat the bot. On Hard it never loses, so a draw is a win!
facts: Play a friend on one device, or the bot
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: a friend on the same device, or the bot.
Take turns drawing your mark in an empty square. Blue X is Player 1 (or you), pink O is Player 2 (or the bot).
Get three in a row across, down or corner to corner to win the round.
Fill the board with no line of three and it's a draw. Who goes first swaps every round.
controls: Tap or click a square to draw your mark.
New round starts a fresh board. Mode lets you switch between a friend and the bot.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Take the middle square if it's free. It's part of four different lines.
Corners come next: they're part of three lines each.
Always check if the other player has two in a row before you go, and block it.
Make two lines at once (a fork) and the other player can only block one.
about: Tic-Tac-Doodle is tic-tac-toe, the game everyone has drawn in the margins of a notebook during a long lecture, redrawn in coloured pencil.
It's a gentle first game against a computer for little ones on Easy, and a real puzzle on Hard, where the bot plays perfectly and the best you can do is a draw.

games.name: Doodle SOS
games.tagline: Write S or O. Spell S-O-S to score and go again.
games.title: Doodle SOS: Free SOS Pencil Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle SOS free online: the classic SOS pencil-and-paper game on a 6x6 grid. Spell S-O-S to score. Play a friend on one phone or beat the bot.
games.lead: A pencil-and-paper classic for two. Take turns writing an S or an O in the grid. Finish S-O-S in a line, across, down or corner to corner, and you score a point and go again. When the grid is full, the most SOS lines wins.
facts: Play a friend on one device, or the bot
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: a friend on the same device, or the bot.
On your turn, choose S or O with the buttons under the grid, then tap an empty square.
If your letter finishes S-O-S in any direction, it's drawn through in your colour, you score, and you go again.
One letter can finish more than one SOS at once for extra points.
When every square is filled, the player with the most points wins.
controls: Tap S or O to choose your letter, then tap a square to write it.
New round clears the grid. Mode switches between a friend and the bot.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Before you write, look for S _ S gaps (write an O) and S O _ gaps (write an S).
Don't leave an S and an O side by side with a gap: that hands the other player a point.
Near the end, count the safe squares left. Sometimes the best move is the one that gives nothing away.
Scoring keeps your turn going, so one good move can set up a chain of points.
about: SOS has been played on scrap paper for a very long time. It looks simple, but it's a game of setting traps and dodging them.
Our version uses a 6×6 sketchbook grid and draws each SOS in the scorer's coloured pencil, so you can see who earned what at a glance.

games.name: Box Doodles
games.tagline: Join the dots. Close a box to claim it and go again.
games.title: Box Doodles: Free Dots and Boxes Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Box Doodles free online: the classic dots and boxes game drawn in pencil. Join dots, claim boxes and play a friend on one phone or the bot.
games.lead: The dots game from the back of every school notebook. Take turns drawing one line between two dots. Draw the fourth side of a box and it's yours, with your initial in it, and you draw again. When all 25 boxes are claimed, whoever has the most wins.
facts: Play a friend on one device, or the bot
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: a friend on the same device, or the bot.
On your turn, tap the space between two dots that sit next to each other to draw a line.
Close the fourth side of a box to claim it. You score a point and draw another line.
When every box has been claimed, the player with the most boxes wins.
controls: Tap or click between two dots to draw a line. On a keyboard, Tab to a line and press Enter.
New round starts a fresh page. Mode switches between a friend and the bot.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Avoid drawing the third side of a box. It gives the box away.
Early on, draw lines that don't touch any box with two sides already.
Late in the game every move gives something away. Give away the shortest row of boxes you can.
Taking a box lets you move again, so finish off a chain before you make your next safe move.
about: Dots and boxes has been a favourite pencil game since the 1800s. It starts slow and calm, and ends with long chains of boxes changing hands.
On Hard, the bot takes every box it can and always gives away as little as possible, so you'll have to plan ahead to beat it.

games.name: Paper Boats
games.tagline: Find all four hidden paper boats before they find yours.
games.title: Paper Boats: Free Battleship-Style Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Paper Boats free online: a hide-and-seek boat guessing game on graph paper. Hide your boats, guess squares and play a friend or the bot.
games.lead: A guessing game for two on graph paper. Each player hides four paper boats on their own page. Take turns tapping a square on the other player's page: a miss is a splash, and a hit gets a pencil X. Find every square of a boat and it floats away. Find all four boats first to win.
facts: Play a friend on one device, or the bot
Saves your record against the bot
how: Pick who to play: a friend on the same device, or the bot.
Hide your boats: tap Shuffle until you like where they are, then tap Ready. Boats never touch each other.
Take turns tapping a square on the other player's page. A splash means nothing's there; an X means you hit a boat.
Hit every square of a boat to find it. The first player to find all four boats wins.
Playing a friend? The game asks you to pass the phone between turns, so nobody peeks at the other page.
controls: Tap or click a square on the big page to guess it.
Your own page and boats are shown small underneath, with the other player's guesses on it.
New round hides new boats. Mode switches between a friend and the bot.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Spread out your first guesses in a checkerboard pattern. Every boat is at least two squares long, so you'll still find them all.
After a hit, try the squares next to it. After two hits in a line, keep going along that line.
Boats never touch, so the squares all around a found boat are always empty. Don't waste guesses there.
The Boats to find list shows which boats are left. If only the Big boat is left, look for gaps long enough to hold four squares.
about: Paper Boats is our take on the classic grid guessing game, with folded paper boats on a sketchbook page instead of anything scary. Hits are pencil X's and misses are splashes.
The bot gets cleverer with each level: on Easy it mostly guesses, on Medium it hunts around its hits, and on Hard it works out where boats could still be hiding.

games.name: Pencil Parade
games.tagline: Steer a growing parade of little pencil stubs through number gates down a page of lined paper, then climb the book stack for a big bonus.
games.title: Pencil Parade: Free Number Gate Runner Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Pencil Parade free online: steer a parade of pencil stubs through number gates, dodge bouncy balls and climb the book stack for a bonus.
games.lead: Steer a crowd of pencil stubs toward the book stack. Your crowd count changes the value of every gate, so the same fork can call for a different turn on the next run.
facts: Endless levels that get longer and faster
how: Start with ten pencil stubs. They move forward on their own. Drag sideways to guide them into one side of each fork.
Read the sign on that side. Blue gates add or multiply your crowd. Purple gates subtract pencils or divide the count in half.
Steer around holes, ink, bouncy balls and the compass. A stub that hits one leaves the crowd. Losing the last pencil ends the run.
Reach the stack and watch the pencils climb. The bonus uses the number that reached the books, multiplied by the highest book reached and then by ten. The next stage starts a fresh crowd.
controls: Phone or tablet: drag your finger left or right anywhere on the screen. The parade moves with your finger, so you don't need to touch the pencils.
Computer: click and drag left or right with the mouse.
Keyboard: hold the Left and Right arrow keys or A and D to steer. Press P or Escape to pause.
The question mark button shows how to play and pauses the game. The speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: When both gates subtract pencils, read them even if you have to steer away from a favorite side. Taking the smaller loss protects the count you bring to the books.
Look one obstacle beyond a good gate. A bonus that drops your whole crowd into an ink puddle is harder to keep.
about: At a fork marked +10 and ×2, a parade of six can leave with sixteen pencils on the +10 side or twelve on the ×2 side. Arrive with fifteen pencils and +10 gives twenty-five while ×2 gives thirty. At ten pencils the two gates tie, so choose the clearer lane beyond them.
games.guide_title: Do the gate arithmetic before steering

games.name: Squiggle Worm
games.tagline: Steer a hand-drawn striped squiggle worm around a page of graph paper, gobble glowing ink dots and grow the longest.
games.title: Squiggle Worm: Free Online Snake Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Squiggle Worm free online: a pencil-doodle snake game on graph paper. Eat glowing ink dots, grow the longest and out-squiggle the other doodles.
games.lead: Follow the glowing ink across the page and try to become the longest striped worm. A dash spends some of the very length you're trying to keep.
how: Guide the moving worm toward clusters of ink dots. Eating them lengthens your body and raises the score shown on the leaderboard.
Keep your head clear of other worms' bodies and the edge of the page. When a rival hits your body, follow its trail of dropped ink for extra length.
Use Zoom for a short dash. Your body gets shorter while boosted, so release it when you have reached the opening or the food you were chasing.
The board lists the five longest worms and shows your rank underneath if you haven't made the top five. See how high you can climb before a collision ends the run.
controls: Phone or tablet: drag anywhere to steer, like a joystick. Hold the Zoom button (or a second finger) to dash.
Computer: your worm squiggles toward the mouse pointer. Hold the mouse button to dash.
Keyboard: arrow keys or W A S D to steer, Space to dash.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Zoom stops working as your length drops to eleven. At that size, leave room to steer clear of other worms without relying on a burst of speed.
The dangerous end of a crossing is your head. Let a rival's head run into your trailing body, then look for the dropped ink after the path opens.
about: When a rival bursts near the page edge, aim along the trail of ink blots with room to turn back toward the middle. Hold Zoom for the straight part and release before the bend. Dashing almost doubles your speed and makes your turning arc wider, so a late turn can carry you off the page.
games.guide_title: Plan the turn before you press Zoom

games.name: Cookie Drop
games.tagline: Snip the strings and swing a chocolate-chip cookie down to Doodle, the hungry doodle monster.
games.title: Cookie Drop: Free Cut-the-Rope Physics Puzzle | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Cookie Drop free online: swipe to snip strings and swing a cookie to Doodle the hungry monster. 32 pencil-drawn physics puzzles on a corkboard.
games.lead: Doodle is waiting under a cookie that swings from red thumbtacks. Cut one string and the others decide where the cookie goes. There are 32 corkboard puzzles to solve, each with three gold stars to collect on the way down.
facts: Saves your stars and best score
how: Find Doodle on the board and trace a route from the cookie to his mouth. You can clear the level with a catch even if you miss a star.
Swipe through one string at a time. With a string still attached, the cookie swings around its pin. Cut the last string to release it.
Collect gold stars by touching them with the cookie. Later boards add bubbles that lift it, paper clips that catch it, balls that bounce it and blowers you can tap for a push.
Feed Doodle to unlock the next board. If the cookie falls into the ink, retry and change the order or timing of your cuts.
controls: Phone or tablet: swipe across a string to snip it. Tap a bubble or a party blower.
Computer: drag the mouse across a string, or just click it. Click bubbles and party blowers.
Press R to restart the level and L to pick a level.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Follow the string back to its thumbtack before cutting. That shows you which pin will still be holding the cookie and which way it can swing.
On a level with a bubble, pick the spot where you want the cookie to drop. Let the bubble carry it there, then tap to pop it.
You can return to a cleared board from Levels. Use the first run to find a route to Doodle and the next to pick up the stars you missed.
about: Let the cookie settle underneath the two red thumbtacks. Cut the short string on the far left, where the arrow points. Leave the longer string attached. It carries the cookie through the middle star and up toward the star on the right.

For the second cut, watch the cookie instead of the pin. As it reaches the upper-right star and is still travelling right, cut the remaining string. The cookie drops through the lowest star into Doodle’s mouth. All three stars and the catch give you 400 points.
games.guide_title: Level 6 · Three stars on Tick Tock

guide_image.alt: Level 6. An arrow marks the short string below the left red thumbtack. A second string supports the cookie, with three stars between it and Doodle.
guide_image.caption: Tick Tock before the first cut. The longer string stays attached for the swing.

games.name: Desk Strikes
games.tagline: Swipe a pink eraser down a long wooden ruler and knock over ten smiley pencil stubs.
games.title: Desk Strikes: Free Online Bowling Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Desk Strikes free online: a desk bowling game. Roll a pink eraser down a ruler lane, curve it for strikes and play 10 frames with real scoring.
games.lead: Bowl a pink eraser down a wooden ruler. The first three frames give you a calm lane to practise your release before a window draft and a wandering doodle bug complicate the shot.
facts: Saves your best score and strike streak
how: Choose your starting spot across the ruler. Swipe upward toward one side of the front pencil. The dotted preview shows your aim, a quicker swipe adds speed, and a bend in the swipe adds curve.
Knock over the ten pencils in up to two rolls. Clearing them on the first roll is a strike. Finishing them on the second is a spare.
After three calm frames, check the draft before you bowl. A doodle bug starts crossing the ruler in frame seven and can knock the eraser sideways.
Bowl ten frames. A strike counts ten plus your next two rolls. A spare counts ten plus the next roll. In the last frame, roll the bonuses you earned to finish your score out of 300.
controls: Phone or tablet: put your finger on the eraser and swipe up toward the pencils. Tap during the replay to skip ahead.
Computer: click and drag upward from the eraser, then let go.
Keyboard: Left and Right move the eraser, Up or Space starts the aim sweep, press again to lock it, then Space sets the power on the meter.
The speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: Use the dotted preview to check the opening direction of your swipe. Bending the latter part adds curve.
Read the draft arrow from frame four onward. From frame seven, wait for the bug to leave your intended line before starting the swipe.
about: Suppose you knock over seven pencils and pick up the other three. The score for that frame stays open. If the next eraser knocks over eight, the spare is worth 18. If you had started with a strike instead, both rolls from the next frame would count toward the strike bonus.
For a single pencil left standing, slide your starting point into line with it and use a straight swipe. A curve that spreads a full rack can carry an eraser past a narrow spare.
games.guide_title: Why a spare changes the next roll

games.name: Marble Blitz
games.tagline: Aim, let go, and send a stream of glass marbles bouncing into numbered paper cups before they slide off the desk.
games.title: Marble Blitz: Free Marble Shooter Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Marble Blitz free online: aim a stream of glass marbles at numbered paper cups, knock their numbers down and keep the cups on the desk.
games.lead: Every hit knocks one off a numbered paper cup. With a row about to slide off the desk, the best shot can be the one that hits a pink eraser just once.
how: Drag to aim from your doodle buddy’s position. Use the dotted path to preview the first bounce, then release to send the entire stream of marbles.
Each strike subtracts one from a cup’s printed number. At zero, the cup crumples. A paper clip adds a marble for the next turn, a star adds three points, and an eraser clears the cups in its row.
Watch where the first returning marble lands. That is your next starting position. When the volley finishes, the cups step down and a new row enters from the top.
Keep every cup from sliding off the lower edge. Your score is the turn you reached plus the bonuses you collected along the way.
controls: Phone or tablet: drag to aim and lift your finger to flick. Tap the page during a volley to speed it up.
Computer: drag with the mouse and release to flick, or use the left and right arrow keys to aim and Space to flick.
During a long volley, Speed up makes the marbles roll faster and Recall marbles brings them all back. New game starts over.
The Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: A marble that slips behind a cup can hit it on multiple bounces. Aim through a gap when the bottom row is safe.
Speed up lets useful marbles keep bouncing. Recall ends their work early. Use Speed up if a ball is still chipping away at a cup.
about: Suppose the bottom row contains a cup marked 12, and you can reach a pink eraser on that same row. One hit on the eraser clears the cup outright. A paper clip elsewhere adds one marble to your next volley, which comes too late if the 12 slides off the desk this turn. A gold star adds three points but leaves the cup in place.
games.guide_title: Choose between an eraser and a paper clip

games.name: Paper Peaks
games.tagline: Clear three folded-paper peaks of doodle cards by playing one higher or one lower.
games.title: Paper Peaks: Free Tri Peaks Solitaire Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Paper Peaks free online: a pencil-sketched Tri Peaks solitaire. Tap cards one higher or lower, build streaks and clear all three paper peaks.
games.lead: Clear three peaks of doodle cards by building a run on the notepad. Ranks can climb and fall on the same run, and the deck wraps from king to ace.
how: Use the card lying on the notepad as your starting rank. Tap an uncovered card one rank away. Suits can mix, and an ace connects to both two and king.
Each card you take becomes the new rank to follow. Removing both cards covering a face-down card turns it over and makes it available.
When a run ends, tap the stock to change the notepad card. Drawing resets the streak. If you draw a wild star, any exposed card can follow it.
Clear all three peaks. Each top card adds 100 points and each unused stock card is worth 25 more. A dead end with no stock costs a pencil and brings a fresh deal.
controls: Tap or click a card to play it, and tap or click the draw pile to draw.
On a keyboard, press 1 to 0 to play a face-up card (numbered left to right), or use the arrow keys and Enter. Space or D draws, U undoes and H shows a hint.
Undo takes back your last move and Hint circles a good card to play. Both are limited each round. The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: When two cards have the same rank, take the one that lifts the last cover from a face-down card. You'll have another choice before the run ends.
A wild doodle star from the stock accepts any exposed card. Pick a starting rank with a visible follow-up so the wild buys more than one move.
about: Suppose the notepad shows a king and the ace, two and three are all face up. Take them in that order. From a fresh streak those moves pay 10, 20 and 30 points, and you still have every draw card you started with. Check which covered cards turn over before committing to the three.
games.guide_title: Trace the next three ranks before drawing

games.name: Even Sketch
games.tagline: Fill a sheet of graph paper with stars and circles so every row and column balances before the bell rings.
games.title: Even Sketch: Free Binary Logic Puzzle Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Even Sketch free online: fill graph paper with stars and circles so every row and column balances. Endless logic puzzles from 4x4 to 8x8.
games.lead: Half the marks in every graph-paper row and column must be stars, and half circles. A single pencilled clue can settle several squares if you follow it in both directions.
how: On the first four-by-four page, leave the shaded clues in place. Tap an empty cell once for a star, twice for a circle, and a third time to clear it.
Fill half of each row and half of each column with each mark. Check both directions as you work. A run of three equal marks breaks the rule.
Read the signs between cells. An equals sign connects two of the same mark. A multiplication sign connects opposite marks. Pink highlights show which entries conflict.
Finish the grid before the bell. Each remaining second adds five points to the solve bonus, and a page finished without a hint earns an extra bonus.
controls: Phone or tablet: tap a square to cycle star, circle and empty.
Computer: click a square to cycle star, circle and empty.
Keyboard: arrow keys move, Space or Enter cycles, 1 draws a star, 2 a circle and 0 erases. U undoes and H gives a hint.
Undo takes back your last move, Hint reveals one correct square for 10 seconds off the bell timer, and Erase clears the sheet.
The speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: On six-square pages, count to three of each mark. On eight-square pages, count to four.
Look for two known squares with one blank between them before trying a guess. Two matching endpoints force the opposite mark into the gap.
about: Start with a four-square row showing star, blank, star, blank. The middle blank must be a circle because three stars in a row would break the rule. There are already two stars, so the last blank must also be a circle. Now look down the columns under both new marks. If a × badge connects a circle to an empty square below, that square must be a star.
games.guide_title: Finish a four-square row in two steps

games.name: Doodle Keeper
games.tagline: Guess the hidden word one letter at a time before a bouncing eraser rubs your doodle house off the page.
games.title: Doodle Keeper: Free Word Guessing Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle Keeper free online: guess hidden words letter by letter from a clue before a cheeky eraser rubs out your doodle house. Over 900 words.
games.lead: The house loses a piece with each wrong guess. Read the clue and use the pattern of filled tiles to find letters that can do more than one job.
how: Read the category clue and count the blank tiles. Pick a letter. All of its appearances fill in at once for ten points apiece.
A wrong guess lets the eraser take one piece of the house. You have six pieces through level eight, five on levels nine through fifteen, and four after that.
Use Peek if the clue has you stuck. It uncovers a remaining letter for one house piece, or uses a free Peek if you have one. Solving five words earns another free Peek.
Finish the word for 50 points per surviving piece plus ten per level. A streak of words without a wrong guess multiplies that bonus, up to three times.
Losing the whole house reveals the answer and costs a pencil. With a pencil left, try a new word at the same level. The third lost pencil ends the run.
controls: Phone or tablet: tap the sticky-note keys to guess a letter. Tap Peek to reveal a letter.
Computer: click the sticky-note keys.
Keyboard: type any letter to guess it. Press Enter to start, to get a new word, or to play again.
The speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: Count spaces as well as letters. A school supply in two words can be PAPER CLIP or GLUE STICK, and their two word lengths differ.
A paid Peek uses one piece and reveals every copy of one remaining letter. With one piece left, only a free Peek will work.
about: Consider ERASER, one of the school-supply words. Guessing E fills the first and fifth tiles for 20 points. R then fills the second and last for another 20. Only A and S remain. Repeated letters are especially useful when the house is down to its last few pieces.
games.guide_title: Two Es for one guess

games.name: Letter Scramble
games.tagline: Swipe across a tray of paper letter tiles to find as many words as you can before the timer runs out.
games.title: Letter Scramble: Free Word Search Swipe Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Letter Scramble free online: swipe across paper letter tiles to spell words, hit the target score in 80 seconds and turn the page to new levels.
games.lead: Look for a turn, not just a straight line. A word can snake diagonally through the tray, and taking it through the gold-star tile doubles its score.
how: Start on any letter in the four-by-four tray. Draw a path through touching tiles, diagonals included, to make a word of at least three letters. Each tile gets one visit per word.
Look at the preview before lifting your finger. Green means the word will score. Yellow marks one already found this round. Gray means the game does not recognise it.
From three letters up to eight, the scores are 100, 300, 600, 1,000, 1,500 and 2,200. Longer words also earn 2,200. Include the gold-star tile to double any of those totals.
Page one needs 1,500 points by the end of its 80 seconds. Later pages set higher targets. Your overall score carries over, and each fresh tray has its own target to meet.
controls: Phone or tablet: swipe your finger across the tiles, then lift it to score the word. Slide back one tile to undo it.
Computer: click and drag across the tiles, then let go.
Keyboard: type a word to light up its path, press Enter to score it, Backspace to delete a letter and Escape to clear.
The Qu tile counts as two letters, Q and U.
The speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: Plan the final tile before releasing. An adjacent S or D can turn an existing path into a second scoring word.
On a keyboard, type a word you can see. When it has several valid paths, the game automatically prefers one through the gold-star tile.
about: Imagine C, A and T touching in sequence, with an unused gold-star S next to T. Submit CAT for 100 points. Follow the same path again and finish on S. CATS is a new four-letter word worth 300, doubled to 600 by the star. Together the two swipes earn 700 points.
games.guide_title: Take CAT twice as far

games.name: Ink Jars
games.tagline: Pour layers of colored ink between glass jars until every jar holds one color.
games.title: Ink Jars: Free Water Sort Puzzle Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Ink Jars free online: pour layers of coloured ink between glass jars until every jar holds one colour. Endless calm sorting puzzles.
games.lead: Each ink colour has a doodle of its own. Follow red stars, blue hearts and yellow moons from jar to jar until every full jar earns a cork.
facts: Saves your level and best score
how: Start with three colours of ink. Read the little symbols on the layers to tell similar colours apart, then tap a source jar and its destination.
Pour into an empty jar or onto ink matching the source’s top layer. Matching layers travel together until the destination fills or the next colour in the source changes.
A full jar of one colour gets a cork. Finish every colour to complete the level. Later pages introduce up to twelve colours and jars that hold five layers.
Compare your move count with par. Finishing at par or below earns three stars, and a shorter solution increases the move bonus.
controls: Phone or tablet: tap a jar to lift it, then tap where to pour.
Computer: click jars, or press 1 to 9 and 0 to pick a jar. The arrow keys and Enter work too.
Undo (or the U key) takes back a pour, 5 times a level. + Jar (or the + key) adds one empty jar per level.
Restart starts the level over. The speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: A jar with room for the entire top band can expose the colour underneath in one move. Count spaces in both possible destinations.
Matching the par move count earns three stars. Trying to beat par gives an extra ten bonus points for each further move you save.
about: Suppose a four-layer jar has two blue hearts over two red stars. A second jar holds three blue hearts. Pouring into that second jar moves exactly one blue layer and corks the jar. One blue layer still covers the red. If you need the red for your next pour, plan a home for that last blue before you start.
games.guide_title: Check how much blue actually fits

games.name: Pencil Patrol
games.tagline: Scribble through a notebook-page maze collecting pencil dots while silly erasers chase you.
games.title: Pencil Patrol: Free Pac-Man Style Maze Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Pencil Patrol free online: guide Stubby the pencil through notebook mazes, collect every dot, dodge giggly erasers and grab a gold star to bonk them.
games.lead: Stubby races four erasers through a maze of pencil dots. Pinky follows Stubby, while purple Smudge tries to meet him up ahead.
facts: 4 pages that repeat and speed up
how: Steer Stubby along the corridors and scribble over the dots. Press a direction slightly before a junction to take the turn as soon as it opens.
Keep clear of the four erasers until you reach a gold sticker. While the erasers are pale, bump into them to score an increasing bonus from that sticker.
Collect the occasional snack or school supply below the pencil case for extra points. Reaching 10,000 points earns one extra pencil.
Gather every dot to turn the page. The four mazes cycle and get faster. Touching an active eraser costs a pencil, and losing your last pencil ends the run.
controls: Phone or tablet: swipe anywhere on the page to steer, or use the arrow pad below the maze.
Computer: arrow keys or W, A, S, D to steer. P pauses and M turns sound on or off.
The Pause button stops the game, and the cross button shows or hides the arrow pad.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Use the side tunnel when an eraser is right on your tail. Stubby keeps his pace there while the pursuing eraser slows.
A single gold sticker starts one scoring chain. Catching two pale erasers during the same sticker pays 200 and then 400 points.
about: In chase mode, Smudge aims four squares ahead of the direction Stubby is facing. If you're going right toward a junction and Smudge is already heading there, queue a turn just before an earlier opening. Turning changes the target, and Pinky still has to follow where you actually went.
games.guide_title: Turn away from Smudge's ambush

games.name: Paper Plane Dash
games.tagline: Fly a paper airplane round the inside of a paper tube: dodge the junk, grab the stars, thread the ring gaps. 10 real folds to unlock.
games.title: Paper Plane Dash: Free Paper Airplane Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Paper Plane Dash free online: fly a paper airplane through a paper tube, dodge erasers and ink blots, grab stars and unlock 10 real paper airplane folds.
games.lead: A fast tube-flying dash drawn in pencil on black construction paper. Your paper airplane flies down a round tube on its own, and you touch or drag on the side of the tube you want to be on: the plane flies round to it the short way, up the sides, over the top and back down, keeping its belly to the wall the whole way. The junk sits on the inside of the tube: crumpled paper balls in every construction-paper colour, erasers, pencil stubs, two-spot-wide rulers and inky blots. Fly round them, fly through the stars, and when a paper ring comes down the tube, get into its gap to fly through for 50 points. Every ten stars start Dart Mode, when your plane fires paper darts that pop everything straight ahead. Catch a magnet to pull stars in, a shield for one free bump, a boost to smash straight through, or a x2 for double points. Every 600 metres turns to a new sector page, each faster than the last, and the stars you collect unlock nine more planes, all real folds: the Basic Glider, Bulldog Dart, Nakamura Lock, Harrier, Hammerhead, Flying Wing, Canard, Stunt Plane and the blue-and-gold Delta Wing.
facts: Touch to fly round the tube
how: Your paper airplane flies down the tube on its own and gets faster with every sector page.
Touch or drag on the side of the tube you want to be on. The plane flies round the inside of the tube to that spot the short way, up the sides, over the top and back, keeping its belly to the wall.

Pick your plane on the start card. The Classic Dart is free, and the stars you collect add up between runs to unlock the Basic Glider, Bulldog Dart, Nakamura Lock, Harrier, Hammerhead, Flying Wing, Canard, Stunt Plane and, last of all, the blue-and-gold Delta Wing.

Dodge crumpled paper, erasers, pencil stubs and paint blobs. Rulers and ink blots are two spots wide. The blue line and the dashed blue arc show your spot; they turn red when something is lined up with you.
Paper rings come down the tube with one gap. Fly round into the gap to pass through for 50 points. Hit the ring and your plane crumples.
Grab gold stars for 10 points each. Every 10 stars fills the meter and starts Dart Mode: for 8 seconds your plane fires paper darts that pop everything straight ahead for 25 points each.
Power-ups: the magnet pulls stars to you, the shield gives you one free bump, the boost smashes through everything (rings too) for 3 seconds, and x2 doubles your points for 10 seconds.
Every 600 metres is a new sector page, with a 100 point bonus. After sector 10, the Ink Vortex, it keeps going faster and faster.
controls: Phone or tablet: touch or drag anywhere on the tube and the plane flies round to that side. Keep your finger down and slide it to steer.
Computer: hold the left or right arrow key (or A and D) to fly round the tube, Up and Down to go to the top or bottom, P or Esc to pause.
Pause stops the action, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: Watch the far end of the tube. Rings show up as a coloured circle long before they arrive, so head for the gap early.
Lines of stars sit in a safe spot, and a ring's stars sit in its gap. Follow them.
The plane always takes the short way round, so a spot straight across the tube is the longest trip. Start moving early.
Dart Mode pops things straight ahead only, so line up with the busiest column while it lasts.
A boost makes you invincible and even smashes rings for 50 points, so spin into the junk on purpose.
Stars count toward new planes even on a short run, so grab every line of them you can.
about: Paper Plane Dash is an original Sketchpad Arcade game, not a twin of anything on our sister site. Your paper airplane flies down the inside of a round tube drawn on black construction paper, and you touch the side of the tube you want to be on. The plane rolls round to it the short way, belly to the wall, dodging crumpled paper balls, erasers, rulers and ink blots.

Every plane you can unlock is a real fold you could make at a desk, from the Basic Glider and Bulldog Dart to the Nakamura Lock, Harrier, Hammerhead and Delta Wing. Stars unlock them, rings and Dart Mode keep a good run exciting, and every 600 metres turns to a faster sector page.

games.name: Margin Merge
games.tagline: Drop smiling doodle balls into a glass jar and merge matching pairs, all the way up to a Super Doodle.
games.title: Margin Merge: Free Suika-Style Merge Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Margin Merge free online: drop doodle balls into a glass jar and merge matching pairs into bigger doodles, all the way up to a Super Doodle.
games.lead: Read the pencil patterns on the balls as they settle. Two Dots grow into a Stripe, and a well-placed Stripe can carry that first merge into a Zigzag.
how: Slide the waiting doodle over the jar, then release to drop it. Two balls need the same pattern and must physically touch to merge.
Learn the pictures in order as the jar fills. Dot becomes Stripe, then Zigzag, Swirl, Checkers and Sprinkles. The upper tiers are Wiggles, Starry, Confetti, Rainbow and Super Doodle.
Each ordinary merge creates one ball of the next pattern and scores points. Two Super Doodles collect a final 100-point bonus and leave the jar.
Watch balls at the dotted top line. A quick hop can settle safely, but a pile that stays over the line for about two and a half seconds finishes the run.
controls: Drag or move your mouse to aim, then release or click to drop. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and Space.
Pop removes one doodle of your choice. You start with one and earn another every 500 points.
New game starts over, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: Put a small waiting ball on the lower side of a slope. Its matching partner can roll down to it even when you cannot drop straight onto the pair.
When an unmatched doodle is all that separates two large matching balls, tap Pop and select that blocker. Let the balls settle before taking your next drop.
about: Suppose a Dot rests against a Stripe on the jar floor. Drop your next Dot against the first one, on the side closest to the Stripe. The Dots combine into another Stripe. If that new ball touches the waiting Stripe, the pair becomes a Zigzag. Leaving a different doodle between them interrupts the chain.
games.guide_title: Give the new Stripe somewhere to roll

games.name: 2048 DROP
games.tagline: Drop numbers, merge matching balls and work your way to 2048.
games.title: 2048 Drop: Free Number Merge Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play 2048 Drop free online: drop numbered balls into a pencil-sketched jar, merge matching numbers and reach 2048 before the jar fills.
games.lead: A blue 2 is only a small drop until it nudges another 2 into a green 4. Pick the landing spot for each numbered ball and see how far one drop can carry through the jar.
facts: Saves your best and daily scores
how: Look at the number above the jar. Slide it over the place you want it to land, then release your finger or click the mouse.
Let the ball roll. Matching numbers combine on contact and double in value. A 16 made from two 8s adds 16 points before any chain bonus.
Use the two preview balls to decide what space to leave on the surface. Quick consecutive merges score extra, and play continues beyond 2048.
Watch the dashed line when the pile gets high. You have about two and a half seconds of danger time to bring it down.
controls: Computer: move the mouse to aim and click to drop. Arrow keys aim and Space drops.
Phone and tablet: drag to aim and lift your finger to drop.
NEXT shows the ball you'll drop next, plus a smaller preview of the one after it. The Sound button turns effects on or off.
tips: Check both preview balls. If a matching number is two drops away, keep a clear route to its partner while you place the intervening ball.
When the red line is crowded, work on an exposed pair at the top. A promising pair buried at the bottom cannot help until the balls above it move.
about: Look for a loose 2 resting against a 4. Drop another 2 on the side nearest the 4. The first pair makes a 4 at the point where the two balls met. If that new 4 touches its neighbour promptly, the pair becomes an 8 and earns a chain bonus.
The same drop on the far side can leave you with two 4s and a hill between them. Watch where the first ball actually rolls before choosing your next release.
games.guide_title: Turn a dropped 2 into an 8

games.name: Shoe String Swing
games.tagline: Lasso push-pins with a shoestring and swing a caped kid through the city, the mountains, the farm and beyond.
games.title: Shoe String Swing: Free Swinging Superhero Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Shoe String Swing free online: lasso push-pins with a shoestring and swing a caped kid through the city, mountains and farm. See how far you can go.
games.lead: A caped kid, a shoestring and a line of push-pins are all you need to cross the skyline. The direction you're already traveling when you let go shapes the next jump.
how: Hold down while a push-pin has a dashed ring around it. The kid attaches a shoestring to that anchor and begins to swing.
Release to fly. As another anchor comes within reach, hold again to catch it and start the next arc.
Collect stars suspended between the pins for five points each. An occasional bouncy ball can send you back up if you are low.
Keep the kid off the ground to extend the run. Distance counts toward the score, and each thousand meters takes you to a new scene with more pins ahead.
controls: Press and hold anywhere on the playfield to grab, and let go to fling. On a keyboard, hold Space or the Up arrow.
Bounce off the bouncy balls for a free boost.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: A soap bubble lasts less than a second after you first grab it. Use it for a short change of direction instead of waiting for a full swing.
A target ring is a better guide than screen position. The game favors reachable pins ahead of you, so crossing close to an old pin doesn't necessarily make it the next catch.
about: On a fixed pin, hold as the kid drops toward the bottom of the arc. Release as the kid starts moving up and forward on the far side. From there, look for the dashed target ring on a pin ahead. Releasing on the way down leaves less height to reach it.
games.guide_title: Let the shoestring carry you past the pin

games.name: Note Quest
games.tagline: Guess the secret word in each note in six tries, with colour clues after every guess.
games.title: Note Quest: Free Wordle-Style Word Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Note Quest free online: guess the secret word in six tries with green and yellow letter clues. Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced levels.
games.lead: A note hides a word. Type a guess to learn which letters belong, which seats they belong in, and whether a repeated letter is using up a guess you could spend on something new.
how: Choose a difficulty, fill one row with a real word, and press Enter. Beginner starts with four-letter notes and seven guesses per note.
Keep green letters in place. Move yellow letters to another position. A gray tile means there is no unused copy of that letter left in the answer after the other colored tiles are counted.
Beginner allows two hints per note. Intermediate gives one hint and six guesses, dropping to five guesses from note sixteen. Advanced allows five guesses with no hints.
Solve early for a higher score. Using a hint halves the base points for that note. Running out of guesses costs a star and breaks your streak.
You begin with three stars. If you have lost one, a streak of three solved notes on Beginner or five on the other modes earns one back.
controls: Tap the letters on the on-screen keyboard, or type on your computer keyboard.
Enter checks your guess and the delete key removes a letter.
Hint shows you one letter of the secret word for half points. Beginner gets 2 hints per note, Intermediate 1, Advanced none.
tips: A yellow letter needs a different seat. Before submitting, check that your new word actually moves it away from every position where it was yellow.
On Beginner you start each note with two hints. If two plausible endings fit the same green letters, a revealed position can save a guess.
about: Imagine guessing BELL when the hidden word is BELT. B, E and the first L turn green. The last L turns gray because the one L in BELT has already been accounted for. Keep BEL, then spend the last space testing another ending.
games.guide_title: Read the two Ls in BELL

games.name: Eraser Gulp
games.tagline: Steer a hungry little eraser and gulp up the desk to grow.
games.title: Eraser Gulp: Free Grow-and-Eat Arcade Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Eraser Gulp free online: steer a hungry eraser around a school desk, gulp paper clips, pencils and backpacks, and grow before time runs out.
games.lead: Paper clips and gold stars are a little eraser’s first meal. Circle back to the big desk supplies as the eraser grows and see how much time you can leave on the clock.
how: Start the first desk with 50 seconds on the clock. Steer the eraser over the smallest supplies and watch the size meter as they disappear.
Touch the centre of an object you can swallow. A red outline means it is still too large. Keep that spot in mind for the return trip.
Keep eating until the size meter reaches its goal. Remaining seconds convert into bonus points, and the next desk has a higher growth target.
Reaching the time limit before reaching the size target ends the run, even if you collected a lot of supplies.
controls: On a phone or tablet, drag your finger and the eraser follows it.
With a mouse, move the pointer over the desk and the eraser swirls toward it.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Move your finger farther from the eraser to cover a long stretch quickly. Bring it closer for a tight turn around a small object.
If the eraser is already large enough, take the bigger of two equally close items. Larger supplies give more points and growth per gulp.
about: When a pushpin pouch flashes red, keep moving around its edge. Look for the smaller supplies clustered nearby and scoop up the ones that fit. As the eraser grows, circle back past the pencil cases, rulers and tape dispensers. The size announcement tells you when the next kind is within reach.
Finishing with six seconds showing can be worth 60 bonus points. Late in a level, several reachable objects nearby can be a better finish than crossing the desk for one large item.
games.guide_title: Make a loop around an oversized item

games.name: Sidewalk Hop
games.tagline: Hop a kid across busy streets and a creek before the rain catches up.
games.title: Sidewalk Hop: Free Crossy Road-Style Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Sidewalk Hop free online: hop Milo across busy streets and a creek, dodge cars and scooters, ride logs and stay ahead of the rainstorm.
games.lead: Milo can hop in all four directions. At the creek, floating logs and planks carry him sideways even when your finger is off the controls.
how: Use the directional controls to hop one square. Milo can move sideways along the sidewalk or step back to wait for a better opening.
Cross traffic one lane at a time. Trees, benches and other sidewalk objects block their squares, so check where your hop will finish.
At the creek, land on a log, crate or plank. It carries you along. Hop to the next support or the bank before it floats off the page.
Keep ahead of the rain. A new farthest row earns one point and a gold star adds five. Traffic, open water and the storm can all end the run.
controls: Tap the arrow buttons under the street to hop forward, left, right or back.
You can also tap the street to hop forward, or swipe in any direction.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D. Space also hops forward.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Backtracking can keep Milo safe from a car. Row points come from the farthest row reached, so hopping back and forth across the same line won't pad the score.
A star is worth five new rows. Take one on a safe landing, but check the rain and the side of the screen before riding a log after it.
about: From the bank, look where a long log is drifting and check the next row for a place to land. If the openings don't line up yet, ride the log a little farther before hopping forward. A long log gives you up to three squares of landing space, a plank two, and a crate just one.
games.guide_title: Use the creek current to pick a landing

games.name: Paper Gates
games.tagline: Slide patterned blocks out through the gates that match their colour.
games.title: Paper Gates: Free Block Sliding Puzzle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Paper Gates free online: drag patterned blocks around a graph-paper board and slide each one out through the gate that matches its colour.
games.lead: Each patterned block has an exit somewhere around the paper frame. Work backward from the opening to find where the whole shape needs to stand.
how: Choose a piece and find an opening with the same color along the frame. Check that the opening can take the whole side of the piece.
Hold the piece and drag it through empty squares. If a corner catches, move the obstruction or approach along a different row.
Bring the piece against its matching gate. Once the shape lines up, it slips out and earns ten points for each square it occupied.
Empty the frame before the clock runs down for a bonus of five points per remaining second, rounded up. A timeout costs one of your three hearts.
controls: Press on a block and drag. It slides straight toward your finger, one square at a time, and stops when something is in the way.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: For a top or bottom gate, line up the block's full width with the opening. For a side gate, compare its height instead.
If a wide piece will not pass a corner, park the smaller obstruction in an empty side pocket. The path must fit the whole block at each step of the drag.
about: A bar three squares tall and one square wide can slip through a one-square opening at the top if its column is clear. To slide the very same bar out the right edge, you need a matching opening three squares tall. Check that measurement before moving another block out of its way.
games.guide_title: Measure the block across the opening

games.name: Doodle Stacks
games.tagline: Stack coloured-pencil discs by colour and pop them in tens.
games.title: Doodle Stacks: Free Hexa Stack Sort Puzzle | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle Stacks free online: drag stacks of coloured-pencil discs onto a hexagon board, match top colours and pop ten of a kind for combos.
games.lead: A stack can hide its most useful colour under the top few discs. Choose an empty hex where a matching neighbour will uncover what you need next.
how: Pick one of the three tray stacks and drag it to a vacant hex. You get a fresh tray after placing all three.
Look at the exposed discs once the stack lands. Adjacent stacks with the same top colour transfer their matching top discs together. The colours underneath stay put until uncovered.
A band of ten or more matching top discs clears for points. Let the board finish moving before planning again. New neighbours can set off a second clear and a combo.
Reach the disc target to turn the page. On a full board, Wipe can remove a stack if you still have it. A full board with no Wipe ends the run.
controls: Press on a stack in the tray and drag it onto the board. You can also tap a stack and then tap an empty spot.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
On a keyboard, press 1, 2 or 3 to pick a stack, move with the arrow keys and press Enter to drop it. W uses the Wipe.
The Wipe button clears one stack off the board, once per level.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Only an unbroken band at the top can hop. Two yellow discs under a pink disc do not count toward a yellow ten yet.
Before filling a gap between two tall stacks, compare the top colour of every tray piece. A connecting hex can bring several stacks into the same move.
about: Say a stack has seven yellow discs showing and three more yellow discs sit on top of your tray stack. Put that tray stack next to the seven. The ten yellow discs can join and pop. If a second colour lies underneath, check whether it will now touch a matching neighbour and set off another move.
games.guide_title: Count the top band, then look underneath

games.name: Scribble Slice
games.tagline: Swipe to slice the juicy fruit that leaps up over the cutting board.
games.title: Scribble Slice: Free Fruit Slicing Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Scribble Slice free online: swipe to slice juicy watermelons, pineapples and mangoes over a cutting board, chain combos and dodge inky bombs.
games.lead: Fruit flies up through your drawing of a cutting board. Watch where the fruit paths meet, then cut across them while there is clear paper between your finger and the ink bomb.
how: Watch the first fruit come up from the bottom. Swipe through it with a finger or drag the mouse across it to split it for ten points.
Keep a single stroke moving through nearby fruit to add a combo when the stroke finishes. Lift before crossing an ink bomb.
A missed fruit costs a star when it drops out of sight, and slicing a bomb costs one too. Cutting the special bouncy ball briefly slows the action.
Start with three stars and see how long you can last. Passing a 500-point mark restores a missing star.
controls: Press and drag your finger across the screen to slice. With a mouse, hold the button down and drag.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
Press Enter or Space to start a new game.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: The golden apple gives 50 points by itself. When it is on the opposite side from a pair of ordinary fruit, picking it off with a short stroke is still worthwhile.
Slice the bouncy ball for four and a half seconds of slow motion. Use the extra time to spot the bomb's path before lining up another combo.
about: Two ordinary fruit cut together earn 30 points, ten each plus a ten-point double. Catch three in the same stroke and the total rises to 60. If an ink bomb is between the second and third pieces, lift your finger and start a clean cut on the far side to protect a star.
games.guide_title: Decide whether the third fruit is worth the swipe

games.name: Sketch Search
games.tagline: Find the hidden words in a board of graph-paper letter tiles.
games.title: Sketch Search: Free Online Word Search Puzzles | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Sketch Search free online: a sketchbook word search with a new theme every round and Beginner to Advanced levels. Drag across tiles to find words.
games.lead: This word search lets you mark an answer in either direction. If an unusual last letter catches your eye, follow the word backward from there.
how: Choose a difficulty, read the theme, then pick a word from the list beside the letter board.
Touch one end of the word and drag along a straight line to the other end. Let go to mark it. Found words are crossed off the list.
Find the remaining words before the clock expires. Hint pairs a word in the list with its flashing first letter on the grid.
Clearing a puzzle earns a time bonus and replenishes a hint up to the limit. Running out of time costs a star and gives you a fresh puzzle if you have a star left.
controls: Press on the first letter of a word and drag to the last letter, then let go.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
Tap Hint (or press H) to flash the first letter of a word you haven't found.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Intermediate adds a downward diagonal in level two, an upward diagonal in level three, and backward placements from level four. Only scan the directions your level uses.
An eight-letter find starts at 100 points before speed or difficulty bonuses. Look for the longest distinctive sequence when two possible words catch your eye.
about: On Beginner, words are placed left to right or top to bottom. Find a word's last letter and check left and above for the letter that comes before it. Once you can trace the whole word in reverse, drag from the last letter to the first. The game accepts the swipe from either end.
games.guide_title: Drag the word from whichever end you spot

games.name: Pencil Putt
games.tagline: Pull back, aim and putt your way round a mini golf course on a school desk.
games.title: Pencil Putt: Free Online Mini Golf Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Pencil Putt free online: a top-down mini golf game on a school desk. Pull back, aim and putt past ink spills and a wind-up mouse. 36 holes plus endless.
games.lead: The rulers, sharpeners and spilled ink on this school desk form 36 mini-golf holes. A useful first putt often changes the angle of your second one.
how: Press anywhere on the course and drag backward. The dotted line previews your aim, and a longer pull adds power. Release to putt.
Work around the desk objects. Shavings slow a rolling ball. Blue arrows and slopes can bend your line, and spilled ink adds a penalty stroke.
Sink the ball and compare your stroke count with the hole's par. Staying on par keeps your stars. Going over costs one, and an ace can restore a missing star.
Play through the 36-hole course while you have stars left. The next tour mirrors the layout and speeds up the moving hazards.
controls: Press anywhere, pull back to aim and set the power, then let go to putt.
Works with a finger on a phone or tablet and with a mouse on a computer.
On a keyboard, the left and right arrows aim, up and down set the power and Space putts.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: On hole one, Welcome Walk, the tee and cup line up down the center. Use that straight approach to learn how far a medium pull rolls.
Each hole scores separately. On the first tour a par earns 300 points, one under par earns 450, and a hole in one earns 1,000.
about: On the first tour, hole four is Shavings Gate, a par three. A ruler reaches from the left wall past the center of the green. From the tee, look up the right side for the gap between the ruler's tip and the outer rail. Set up a shot through that gap before turning back toward the cup on the left.
games.guide_title: Play the open side of Shavings Gate

games.name: Letter Links
games.tagline: Link words around a chalk path in the park and turn all twelve letters gold. Three difficulties.
games.title: Letter Links: Free Word Link Puzzle Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Letter Links free online: tap chalk letters around a park path to make linked words, use all twelve letters in as few words as you can and beat par.
games.lead: Twelve letters sit on four sides of the chalk path. Where a word ends decides the first step of the next word, so a short word with the right ending can open the board.
facts: Saves your best score and progress
how: Read the three letters on each side of the chalk path. Tap a word one letter at a time, changing sides with every tap. A letter can appear again after you visit another side.
Press Enter to submit a word. Its letters turn gold. The final letter stays in place to begin the next word. Use all twelve letters to clear the board and aim for the displayed par.

Beginner starts with four hints and allows seven words per puzzle. Intermediate uses the full 72-puzzle set with a six-word limit and 1.5× scoring. Advanced requires words of at least four letters and allows five words for 2× scoring.
Running out of words or skipping a board costs one of three hearts. Progress and best scores are kept separately for each difficulty, so you can change modes from the start, help or game-over screen.
