controls: Computer: click or drag across letters, or type them on the keyboard. Enter plays the word and Backspace deletes a letter.
Phone or tablet: tap letters or slide your finger from letter to letter, then tap Enter.
Hint shows the next letter of a good solution. Restart clears your words for this puzzle.
The sound button turns the sound effects on or off.
tips: An already-gold letter still works as a bridge. SPRINGS uses its first and last S to connect two different words.
If your last word leaves a poor starting letter, use Delete while only that starting letter is showing. You can revise the previous word.
about: On the board with sides PCN, ATG, RSL and OIE, try PLANTS. P to L changes sides, L to A changes again, and the same rule holds for the rest of the word. Its final S starts SPRINGS. That also ends in S, letting SCONE cover the last untouched letters. The three words use all twelve letters on this par-four board.
games.guide_title: A three-word route through twelve letters

games.name: Sketch Sprint
games.tagline: Race a twisting sketchbook path through downtown, the backyard, the park, the creek and the woods. Swipe to turn, jump and slide.
games.title: Sketch Sprint: Free Endless Runner Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Sketch Sprint free online: a fast endless runner drawn in pencil. Pick a runner, swipe to turn, jump and slide through downtown, the park and the woods.
games.lead: A fallen log calls for a jump, an overhead net for a slide, and the sign at a corner points down a whole new stretch of track.
how: Your runner moves forward automatically. Swipe sideways on straight stretches to change lanes and collect stars. Stars start at ten points each.
Swipe up for low obstacles and gaps, or swipe down to pass under an overhang. A tall wall requires an open lane alongside it.
Look for the sign and rail at a ninety-degree corner. Swipe in the sign's direction shortly before reaching the turn to keep running.
Stars add to your runner unlocks between attempts. During a run, each 500-meter wave raises the pace and score multiplier. A head-on collision can end the run.
controls: Computer: use the arrow keys or A and D to change lanes and turn corners, Up, W or Space to jump, and Down or S to slide. You can also drag with the mouse.
Phone or tablet: swipe left or right to change lanes, swipe up to jump and swipe down to slide.
Press P or Esc, or tap the pause button, to take a break.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: A full-height wall takes an entire lane. Move into a clear lane early enough to finish the sideways step before you reach the wall's edge.
After a side bump, take the next clear stretch carefully. The stumble lasts four seconds, and another side hit during that window can end the run.
about: A log followed closely by an overhead net makes a good two-swipe sequence. Swipe up before the log. Once the runner has cleared it, swipe down while still in the air. The runner drops quickly and starts sliding on landing, ready to pass under the net.
games.guide_title: Turn a jump into a low slide

games.name: Doodle Drop
games.tagline: Spin a giant pencil and drop a bouncy striped ball down to the finish platform.
games.title: Doodle Drop: Free Helix Jump-Style Ball Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle Drop free online: spin a giant pencil to line up gaps and bounce a striped ball down ring by ring, dodging scribbles and ink blots.
games.lead: Spin the giant pencil to line up holes in its paper rings. A single safe bounce gives you time to aim, while a clean string of drops gives the striped ball the power to break a ring.
how: The ball bounces by itself. Drag across the screen to turn the giant pencil and bring an opening underneath it.
Pass through openings to descend. An ordinary landing resets your streak and gives you another bounce. A pink scribble or a moving ink blot will pop an unprotected ball.
Connect three drops without landing to light up the ball. It can then break the next solid ring it hits. Longer uninterrupted drops also add more points.
Reach the chequered platform to clear the pencil. If the ball pops, Retry returns you to the beginning of that level.
controls: Computer: drag with the mouse, or hold the arrow keys or A and D to spin the pencil. Press Esc to pause.
Phone or tablet: drag left and right anywhere on the pencil.
The sound button turns the sound effects on or off.
tips: If the openings do not line up, steer onto a plain patch and use the next bounce to turn. A bounce resets the streak.
Watch a moving ink blot for a bounce before crossing its path. A safe spot on the last bounce can be occupied on the next one.
about: Three gaps in succession score 5, 10 and 15 points and light up the ball. If the next ring has a pink wedge below you, the glowing ball can smash through it. After only two gaps, that same wedge ends the attempt. Look for the glow before aiming for a hazard.
games.guide_title: Count the gaps before a pink ring

games.name: Pencil Plunk
games.tagline: Pull thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks on a corkboard and sort them into paper cups.
games.title: Pencil Plunk: Free Tack Sorting Puzzle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Pencil Plunk free online: pull thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks on a corkboard, fill paper cups by colour and plunk every stick onto the desk.
games.lead: The paper cups each want three matching thumbtacks. A loose tack can finish a cup, wait in the pencil case, or let a popsicle stick swing over a tack you were about to pull.
how: Look at the open paper cups and tap a matching exposed thumbtack. A tack shaded beneath another stick has to wait.
Three matching tacks fill a cup. A tack without an open cup goes into the pencil case, where it waits for its color to appear.
A stick can swing once it hangs from just one tack. Remove the last tack to drop the stick and see what it was covering.
Finish by clearing the sticks. If the case fills, a legal pull must match an open cup. The round ends when the case is full and no such tack is accessible.
controls: Phone or tablet: tap a tack to pull it.
Computer: click a tack. On a keyboard, the arrow keys pick a free tack, Enter or Space pulls it, and + adds a slot.
The +1 slot button adds a sixth spot to the pencil case, once per level. Restart level tries the level again.
The sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: With the case full, look for an exposed tack that goes straight to an open cup. It can still be pulled even with no spare space in the case.
Before leaving a stick on a single tack, look underneath it. Pull an accessible cup match first if it sits in the stick's swing path.
about: Suppose your open cup holds two tacks and the Next note matches two tacks waiting in the case. Pull the accessible third tack for the open cup. When the next cup arrives it collects its two matching tacks automatically, opening two spaces without another pull.
games.guide_title: Spend a tack to empty the pencil case

games.name: Draw Brawl
games.tagline: Grab gold stars, fill your fort and dodge the sprinklers against three computer rivals in a backyard brawl.
games.title: Draw Brawl: Free Backyard Arcade Battle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Draw Brawl free online: pick Max, Ruby or Leo, grab gold stars, fill your fort and splat three computer rivals before the sprinklers come on.
games.lead: Four players share one backyard, but each has a fort of their own. A pocketful of gold stars shows what you stand to lose on the way home.
how: Choose Max for a close-range paint roller, Ruby for quick paint shots, or Leo for a cardboard-tube cannon and a box shield. Find your own fort before heading into the yard.
Collect loose gold stars, up to 15 at a time. Stay inside your fort’s ring briefly to add them to your score. A rival fort cannot take a deposit.

A splatted player spills the stars they were carrying and returns after a short delay. Getting close to a rival can start a Showdown. Splat that rival inside the ring before time expires to earn three bonus stars.
Watch the outer lanes when the sprinkler warning appears. They slow you down while your fort stays dry. After two minutes, the most banked stars wins, and tied leaders share the win.
controls: Computer: WASD or the arrow keys move. J attacks and auto-aims at the nearest rival; hold the mouse button to aim shots yourself. Space dashes, Q uses your special, Esc pauses.
Phone or tablet: drag the left side of the screen to move. ATTACK auto-aims, or drag the AIM pad to point your shots where you want them. SPECIAL and DASH are next to it.
The pause button freezes the match. The speaker button turns sound effects on; they start muted.
tips: If a rival is between you and home, steer wide when protecting a full load. Getting close can start an eight-second Showdown.
Forts stay dry when the sprinklers run. Plan your return before the outer lane gets wet and slows you down.
about: Suppose a rival leads 20 to 16 and you carry five stars. Getting those five back to your fort takes you to 21. Picking up one more star in the middle still leaves your score at 16 until you bank. Leave time to stand inside your fort’s ring for the deposit, which takes just under a second.
You can carry 15 at most. A detour across a cluster of stars with full pockets buys you nothing and gives other players another chance to catch you.
games.guide_title: Make the last trip count

games.name: Doodle Darts
games.tagline: Tap at just the right moment to blast the target and nail the gold bullseye.
games.title: Doodle Darts: Free One-Tap Darts Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Doodle Darts free online: a one-tap timing darts game. Throw when your aim drifts over the target, chain bullseyes and unlock new backdrops.
games.lead: The aiming mark wanders across the drawing while your dart waits. Tap for an ordinary hit, or wait for the gold centre and start a run of bullseyes.
how: Watch the aiming mark move, then tap once to throw at its current position. An ordinary hit scores one point and one coin.
Aim for the gold centre to earn a bullseye. Consecutive centres build a scoring streak. When the large bonus star appears, hit it for five points and ten coins.
You start with three darts. An ordinary miss costs one. Hitting a spiky blob ends the run immediately, even if you have darts left.
Check your score against the desk friends after a run. Pencil is the first milestone at ten points.
controls: Tap or click anywhere on the page to throw. On a keyboard, press Space.
The turtle button slows your aim for 5 throws and the target button makes the target bigger for 5 throws. Each costs 25 coins.
Use the Shop on the start screen to spend coins on new backdrops and new things to throw, like a feather or an ice pop.
tips: A spiky blob can finish the run while you still have darts left. Keep your eye on the aiming mark and the blob together.
The large bonus star pays five points and ten coins when hit. Its whole target counts, so you can take a wider shot than you would for a bullseye.
about: Three ordinary hits earn three points. Three consecutive bullseyes earn 2, then 4, then 6, for 12 points. An ordinary hit breaks that chain. If the spiky blob sits along the approach to the centre, watch the mark come around again before committing to a throw.
games.guide_title: What three bullseyes are worth

games.name: Word Workshop
games.tagline: Drag across the letters to spell words and fill a sketchbook crossword.
games.title: Word Workshop: Free Crossword Word Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Word Workshop free online: drag across a ring of letters to spell words and fill a sketchbook crossword. 88 levels from Beginner to Advanced.
games.lead: A wheel of pencil letters supplies a whole crossword. Changing the order of the same letters can fill an entirely different slot without adding anything to the wheel.
how: Choose a difficulty. Begin a swipe at a letter on the wheel, trace a word in order and lift. A crossword answer appears in its slot and reveals letters in any slots that cross it.
Use each wheel tile once per swipe. An accepted word outside the crossword earns a bonus the first time you find it. Every six bonus words pays thirty stickers.

Follow one successful word quickly with another to build the multiplier up to five. Beginner and Intermediate offer a two-letter clue after repeated misses. Advanced counts words of at least four letters and gives four minutes plus ten seconds for each grid word found.
Finish all the crossword entries to open the next page. Completing a level without purchasing a hint earns three stars.
controls: Drag with your finger or mouse across the letters. Slide back to the previous letter to undo it.

Shuffle mixes up the letters. The lightbulb costs stickers per step (10 on Beginner, 15 on Intermediate, 25 on Advanced): first it lights up a starting letter, then the next letter, then shows the word's first letters in the grid.
The star shows your bonus words and personal bests, the bars button lets you switch difficulty or start over, and the speaker button turns sound on or off.
tips: When a wheel is hard to read, shuffle and look at the new neighbors. Shuffling changes the arrangement of the letters, so every word you could make before is still there.
On Advanced, a three-letter guess is too short even if it is a real word. Use a revealed crossing letter to start looking for a four-letter answer.
about: On the Beginner page called Draw, swipe D–R–A–W, lift, then swipe W–A–R–D. DRAW fills the bottom row and WARD runs down the left edge. They share the D in the bottom-left corner. For the shorter entries, try R–A–W down the right or W–A–D across the top.
games.guide_title: Try two readings of the DRAW wheel

games.name: Bubble Doodle
games.tagline: Aim, bounce and pop bubbles before they reach the dashed line.
games.title: Bubble Doodle: Free Bubble Shooter Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Bubble Doodle free online: a pencil-drawn bubble shooter. Aim with the dotted guide, bank shots off the walls and pop matches before the dashed line.
games.lead: One well-placed pencil bubble can take down a whole branch of colours. Aim for the point holding the branch to the ceiling and use the side walls to reach it.
how: Drag until the dotted path ends beside a bubble the same colour as your shot. The dots show side-wall rebounds too. Lift your finger to fire.
One matching neighbour is enough. Every touching bubble of that colour in the group pops, and any bubbles cut off from the ceiling fall. Six successful pops charge a bomb for an upcoming shot.
Count shots as well as colours. Level one can add two rows, one per seven shots. Later pages bring more colours and more frequent rows.
Empty the board to move on. If the bottom of the cluster crosses the dashed danger line, the run ends.
controls: Drag and release with a mouse or finger to aim and shoot.
Tap the waiting bubble to swap it with your current one.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to aim and Space to shoot.
Every 6 pops charges a bomb that clears everything around where it lands.
tips: A shot only needs one neighbour of its colour to start a pop. Use the aiming dots to touch that neighbour from the side.
If two shots can reach the same colour, choose the one that removes support from the lowest branch before the next row arrives.
about: Suppose six bubbles of assorted colours hang from one red bubble, with no other path to the ceiling. One red shot touching that red bubble makes a pair worth 20 points. The six loose bubbles then fall for 240 more. You can leave all six colours alone and earn 260 points with that shot.
Trace both sides of the cluster before firing. Even a thin diagonal connection to the ceiling can hold the whole branch up.
games.guide_title: Read a six-bubble drop

games.name: Four in a Frame
games.tagline: Sort sixteen words into four secret groups of four.
games.title: Four in a Frame: Free Connections Word Puzzle | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Four in a Frame free online: sort sixteen words into four secret groups of four. A new Daily Puzzle every day, plus Beginner to Advanced levels.
games.lead: Sixteen words can hide four ordinary-looking groups. The hard part is deciding which meaning of a word belongs on this particular page.
how: Look over all sixteen words. Select four you could give the same label, then press Check. A solved set moves above the remaining tiles. Yellow is the easiest group and pink the trickiest.
Use the feedback on a miss. “One away” means three belong together. Complete all four groups to earn a bonus for unused tries, on top of the points for each group.

Beginner gives five tries and two hints per puzzle. Intermediate allows four tries, one hint and scores at 1.5×. Advanced allows three tries, no hints and scores at 2×. Each mode keeps its own progress.

In those modes, using up the tries reveals the groups and costs one of three stars. The yellow Daily button opens a separate shared puzzle with an active-play timer, a daily streak and a result you can share.
controls: Tap or click a word to pick it, and tap it again to put it back.
Shuffle mixes up the words, Clear unpicks them, and Hint lights up two words that go together.
On a keyboard, press Enter to check and Escape to clear.
The Sound button turns sound on or off.
tips: Shuffling changes where the tiles sit without changing their groups. Use it to break an association formed just because two words were next to each other.
A hint marks two members of a group together. Use those marks as anchors and test what links both words before spending another try.
about: A “one away” result means exactly three of your four words belong together. Keep that set in mind and inspect the other twelve. If a word seems to fit both your guess and another category, look for three convincing partners for it in the other category. Lock in that group first, then return to the original guess with fewer choices.
games.guide_title: Work backward from “one away”

games.name: Margin Match
games.tagline: Tap doodle tiles off the pile and collect three of a kind in your tray.
games.title: Margin Match: Free Tile Matching Puzzle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Margin Match free online: tap doodle tiles off a stacked pile, collect three of a kind in your 7-spot tray and clear the whole pile to win.
games.lead: You get seven spaces to turn a pile of overlapping doodle tiles into trios. Count how many tiles you must uncover before committing a tray space.
how: Choose a bright tile on the pile and tap it into the seven-place tray. Dark tiles can only be picked after you remove everything overlapping them.
Collect three copies of one drawing to clear that trio. Finish another trio within three and a half seconds to build a scoring combo.
Plan to make a trio by the seventh tile. Taking a seventh that cannot complete a set ends the attempt. You can retry that level.
Clear the pile and finish its trios to advance. Later layouts put more kinds of doodles under taller stacks.
controls: Tap or click a tile to move it to the tray.

Undo puts your last tile back on the pile. Lift moves 3 tiles from your tray up to a holding spot, and you can tap them back in later. Shuffle mixes up the doodles on the pile. You get one of each every level.
The ? button shows the rules and lets you continue from your last level or start a new game.
tips: At five tiles, you have room to remove one cover and then take a third matching tile. Check the tile beneath the cover before spending that first space.
Lift can send three tray tiles to the holding area. Bring one back when it closes a trio, leaving the others there until you have room.
about: At six tiles in the tray, look for a pair already sitting there. If a bright, uncovered tile completes that pair, taking it fills the seventh space for a moment and then clears all three. If its match sits under an unrelated tile, taking the cover first fills the last space with no trio. Use Lift or find another exposed match before touching the cover.
games.guide_title: Can the seventh tile rescue this tray?

games.name: No. 2 Pencil
games.tagline: Link matching classroom doodles before the timer runs out.
games.title: No. 2 Pencil: Free Tile Connect Puzzle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play No. 2 Pencil free online: a tile connect puzzle. Link matching classroom doodles with a path of up to two turns and clear the desk before time runs out.
games.lead: Two matching classroom doodles can see each other around corners. Look for a route with at most two bends, tap both ends, and watch the pencil trace the connection.
how: Pick one classroom doodle, then tap a second tile showing the same drawing. You only need to select the two ends.
The pencil line travels horizontally or vertically through open space, including the blank border. It can bend twice on its way to the second tile.
After a match, the remaining tiles slide in the direction of the board's arrow. Level one slides down, level two left, level three up and level four right.
Empty the board before time runs out. Each pair restores up to one second. Use Hint to reveal a pair or Shuffle to rearrange the remaining tiles.
controls: Tap or click a tile to select it, and tap it again to deselect.
Hint (or the H key) highlights a pair you can match. You get 3 per level.
Shuffle (or the S key) mixes the board. You get 2 per level.
The Sound button mutes all sound effects.
tips: For a high score, look across the board before taking an adjacent pair. A route of six steps earns two stars, and eleven steps earns three.
When a pair shakes, the second tile stays selected. If you see another copy with a clear route, tap it to try again.
about: Suppose two matching tiles sit on the top edge with a solid row of tiles between them. Imagine moving one square up from the first tile, across the blank margin, then down onto its twin. That route has exactly two bends, so the pair clears even though neither tile can move sideways.
games.guide_title: Use the blank margin to join a pair

games.name: Scribble Blocks
games.tagline: Drag shapes onto the board and clear rows and columns.
games.title: Scribble Blocks: Free Block Puzzle Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Scribble Blocks free online: drag coloured-pencil shapes onto an 8x8 grid, fill rows and columns to rub them out and chain combos for big scores.
games.lead: Fit three doodle pieces at a time into a square grid. Before dropping the first one, find a home for the awkward shape in the tray and look for lines that cross.
how: Look at the three shapes in the tray. Drag one over the grid and find an empty space that fits its exact outline.
Line up filled squares from edge to edge across one row or down one column. The preview lights the lines that will clear when you release.
Use the other shapes in whichever order opens the most space. A new tray only arrives after all three have been placed.
There is no clock. Keep placing pieces until none of the shapes left in the tray fits. A starred square earns a bonus when its line clears.
controls: Drag and drop pieces with a mouse or finger.
Undo takes back your last move. You get 3 per game.
New game starts over at any time.
tips: If a tray piece turns gray, see whether one of the other two can clear the space it needs. Gray describes the board as it stands.
Use Undo immediately when you close the only space for a large block. It restores the previous board, tray, score and streak, and spends one of your three undos.
about: Suppose a row and a column are full except for the same empty square. A one-cell piece placed at that crossing clears both. On a fresh streak the line bonus is 40 points, plus the point for placing the piece. Any starred square removed adds another 25.
games.guide_title: Look for the square that clears two lines

games.name: Drop Swap
games.tagline: Swap classroom doodles, match three and clear the scribbles.
games.title: Drop Swap: Free Match-3 Puzzle Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Drop Swap free online: a match-3 puzzle with apples, pencils, books and star stickers. Swap, match three, build power-ups and beat 30 levels.
games.lead: Match apples, pencils and other classroom pieces to clear each page’s assignment. A four-piece line can build a ruler that reaches a stubborn scribble several squares away.
how: Read the assignment above the board before making the first swap. Some pages count particular classroom pieces, while others ask you to erase the scribbles underneath them.
Trade two side-by-side pieces to form a straight line of three or more matching items. Pieces fall into the spaces they leave and can make further matches on the same move.
Work directly on a scribbled square to remove a layer. Dark scribbles need two hits. Rulers and other special pieces can also reach those squares.
Complete the assignment within the move budget. Each unused move adds 250 points at the finish, and the final score determines whether you take home one, two or three stars.
controls: Drag a tile toward its neighbor to swap them, or tap one tile and then the tile next to it.
Levels lets you replay any level you have unlocked.
Restart level starts the current level over.
The Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: A dark scribble needs two hits. A ruler can take off the first layer even if you cannot yet make a normal match on the square.
The paint palette clears a chosen tile kind when swapped with it. Check which kind sits on the most remaining goal squares before choosing a neighbour.
about: Look above the scribble for a horizontal line of four you can complete. That line makes a vertical ruler. In a simple four-match, the ruler appears on the swapped square that joins the line. Line that square up with the scribble’s column, then trigger the ruler in a later match to sweep down the column.
A vertical four works the other way and makes a horizontal ruler. Check the stripe before spending a move to set it off.
games.guide_title: Build a ruler over a hard-to-reach scribble

games.name: Pencil Path
games.tagline: Tap pencils to send them off the notepad, one clear path at a time.
games.title: Pencil Path: Free Unblock Logic Puzzle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Pencil Path free online: tap coloured pencils to slide them off a lined notepad, but only when their path is clear. 60 relaxing logic levels.
games.lead: A pencil leaves the notebook in one straight line. Find a clear exit for one pencil and its empty square can free the next one in the chain.
how: Pick a pencil and follow its tip all the way to the notebook edge. When the full route is open, tap it once to send it out.
Each departing pencil leaves a gap. Check which other tips now point through that gap, then send the next pencil.
A blocked tap costs one of three hearts. Later boards include fixed ink blots that stay where they are as the other pieces leave.
Clear the last pencil to finish the page. Remaining hearts determine the star rating. The score also rewards how quickly you finished.
controls: Tap or click a pencil to send it off the page.
Hint glows on a pencil that can leave safely. Tap it again whenever you need another hint.
Restart level starts the page over, and Levels lets you replay any level you've unlocked.
tips: Follow the entire row or column. One empty square just ahead of the tip gives you room to look, but a pencil farther along can still cost a heart.
To earn three stars, finish with all three hearts. Speed adds points separately, so you can take your time when collecting stars.
about: Start with a right-pointing pencil that has another pencil between its tip and the edge. Leave the first one alone and trace the blocker from its own tip. If that line is clear, send the blocker off first. Now trace the first pencil again in case there was a second blocker behind it.
games.guide_title: Follow the pencil that's blocking your pencil

games.name: Space Blaster
games.tagline: Fly a little rocket and blast the UFOs swooping down from space.
games.title: Space Blaster: Free Retro Space Shooter Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Space Blaster free online: steer a little rocket across grid-paper space and zap saucers, ring ships and a shielded mothership in a retro shooter.
games.lead: Slide a pencil-drawn rocket beneath flights of UFOs. Its firing pattern changes as you advance, so the same aim that works in the first formation feels different in level five.
how: Press and hold to fire while dragging the rocket from side to side. Line up your lasers with the incoming UFOs.
The larger mothership takes two hits. Watch for falling alien goo while firing and avoid a collision with a diving ship.
Clear the formation to reach the next level. Ordinary diving UFOs pay double their formation value, and a gold power star adds a beam for twelve seconds.
You start with three ships. A collision or goo hit costs one. Your first extra ship comes at 20,000 points and another at 70,000.
controls: Hold and drag on the screen to steer and fire. With a mouse, move to steer and hold the button down to fire.
On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or A and D to move, Space to fire and P to pause.
Pause stops the action, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: When a mothership flashes on the first hit, keep a beam on its route for the second. That first flash signals damage to its shield.
A power star lasts twelve seconds. During the early levels it changes your single stream into two, so realign for the new spread before aiming at one small UFO.
about: From level five the regular twin beams leave a gap directly above the rocket. If a narrow target is lined up with your nose and the shots pass either side, slide a little left or right until one stream cuts through it. The power star temporarily adds a third beam down the middle.
games.guide_title: Aim with the gap between twin lasers

games.name: Space Glass
games.tagline: Colour space pictures by number, one pencil colour at a time.
games.title: Space Glass: Free Color by Number Game Online | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Space Glass free online: a relaxing colour-by-number puzzle on grid paper. Fill pixel pictures of rockets, astronauts, UFOs, planets and galaxies.
games.lead: A blank numbered mosaic slowly becomes a rocket, a moon rover or a galaxy. One pencil fills only its own numbered squares, so you can sweep across a whole band of mixed colors.
how: Open a picture and pick a numbered pencil from the tray. The matching squares stand out on the grid.
Tap a matching square for one mark or drag across a group of them. Other colors are skipped as the pencil passes.
Use the plus button or pinch to enlarge tiny details. Once a color is complete, its pencil gets a check and another open color becomes active.
Finish every numbered square to add the picture to your collection. Your device saves filled squares between visits.
controls: Tap or click a square to fill it. Hold and drag to fill a whole row in one go.
Tap a color in the tray to switch, or press 1 to 9 on a keyboard.
The magnifier points out a square you missed, and the Sound button turns sound effects on or off.
tips: Keep one finger down to color a broad patch. Lift it and use two fingers to move the zoomed picture without drawing.
Want to work on a particular part of the picture? Tap an unfinished square there. If another pencil is selected, the game tells you the number you need.
about: When a pencil's counter drops to one, keep that color selected and tap Hint. The remaining square flashes. If you're zoomed in, the board also scrolls to it. Fill it and the tray moves on to the next unfinished pencil.
games.guide_title: Find the last square of one color

games.name: Chibi Chib
games.tagline: Pick up scrambled gems and put each colour back to rebuild cute chibi animals.
games.title: Chibi Chib: Free Gem Sorting Puzzle Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Chibi Chib free online: a relaxing gem sorting puzzle. Pick up misplaced gems and drop them on their coloured squares to finish 17 chibi animal pictures.
games.lead: Kitty’s picture starts as a jumble of coloured gems. A tap picks up a patch, and the tiny dots underneath show which colours belong in the spaces you uncover.
how: Open a picture and find a gem on the wrong colour. Tap it to lift the connected patch it belongs to. Tap the selection again to put it back.
Look for an empty square with a dot matching the gems in your hand. Tap there to fill as many matching spaces as are available. If there is no opening yet, use the tray to make one.
To retrieve a colour, select it in the tray and tap its dotted square on the picture. You can zoom in when the dots are close together.
Fill all the coloured squares and empty the tray to save the finished picture. If the tray fills and no gems can move, the round gets stuck.
controls: Tap or click gems, the tray, tray colours and squares.
Pinch, scroll the mouse wheel or use the + and − buttons to zoom. Drag to move around, and double-tap to zoom in or out.
Hint (10 coins) shows a good move, +1 Row (30 coins) adds 16 tray spots, and Undo (15 coins) takes back your last move.
tips: Tap a dot near the part of the picture you want to finish. The game fills that square first and then the nearest open squares of that colour.
A completed picture earns 10 coins. Finish without a booster for 15, so try a direct swap before spending one.
about: Find two patches whose colours belong in each other’s spaces. Lift the first patch into the tray. Pick up the second and tap a newly exposed dot of its colour. Those gems move straight across the picture, opening spaces for the gems you parked. Bring the first colour back from the tray to finish the exchange.
If the patches have different sizes, only as many gems move as there are open matching squares. Look for another matching dot before sending the leftovers to the tray.
games.guide_title: Use one tray trip to free two patches

games.name: Word Scribble
games.tagline: Drop letter bubbles into a pencil box, merge matching letters and swipe to spell words.
games.title: Word Scribble: Free Letter Merge Word Game | Sketchpad Arcade
games.meta: Play Word Scribble free online: drop letter bubbles into a pencil box, merge matching letters and swipe across nearby bubbles to spell words.
games.lead: The letter bubbles do two jobs. Some form a hidden word that empties part of your pencil box. Others can spell a bonus word for points while staying right where they landed.
how: Release letters into the pencil box from above the pile. Each hidden word has its own color. Bubbles can join on contact into chunks such as TH or ING.
Swipe through nearby bubbles in spelling order or let a chunk complete a word on its own. A hidden word pops, and using its own plain color earns double.

Matching copies of the same letter can merge to silver and then gold. Matching gold copies become a wildcard. Extra real words of three or more letters score once each per level and leave the bubbles in play.

Meet the hidden-word goal at the top to advance. The star word counts twice and starts eight seconds of double scoring. If the stack rises to the dotted line, you have three seconds to clear a hidden word for a Clutch Save.
controls: Start a swipe on a bubble to spell. Slide back to the previous bubble to undo a letter.
Start anywhere else to aim, then let go to drop. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys and Space.
Pop removes one bubble you choose. You get another Pop each level.
tips: A fresh bonus word can help when the board is still low. Spell it before a hidden word uses up one of its letters, and both can contribute to the timed word streak.
Letters of one target share a color. Put that color's next drop close to the others so you can trace the entire word even after the bubbles settle.
about: When a pile reaches the dotted line, look for the letters of a hidden word first. Swipe through those bubbles in order to remove them. An ordinary bonus word can score using the same crowded patch, but its bubbles return to the pile afterward.
games.guide_title: Choose the word that buys more space
